integration.sandboxNote: No real Flutterwave test-mode credentials available in this sandbox. Build agent MUST put all outbound calls behind a FlutterwaveClient interface with a MockFlutterwaveAdapter for contract tests. Real connectivity is an explicit open risk, not silently assumed working — see conventions.md.

actions.name: initCharge
actions.note: Returns tx_ref (server-generated), amount (server-looked-up, never client-supplied), currency NGN, publicKey. Consumed by every payment-shaped resource: Purchase, Tip, DirectMessage, CreditPurchase, CreatorSubscription.

actions.name: verifyCharge
actions.note: GET /v3/transactions/:id/verify against Flutterwave. Cross-check status=successful, amount>=expected, currency=NGN, tx_ref match before any resource is marked completed.

actions.name: refund
actions.note: POST /v3/transactions/:id/refund. No prior implementation anywhere in the WAWU codebase family — new. Used by the DM-deadline-sweep cron for missed-response auto-refunds.

actions.name: createPaymentPlan
actions.note: One-time setup per subscription tier (Basic/Pro), Flutterwave's Payment Plan API. Referenced by CreatorSubscription.flutterwavePlanId.

actions.name: receiveWebhook
actions.note: POST /api/hub/webhooks/flutterwave, auth: provider-signature (verif-hash header checked against FLUTTERWAVE_SECRET_HASH), no user role. Reliability backstop for client-verify flow, and the ONLY signal for recurring subscription-renewal charges (no client involved in those).
